chemical_assumptions: No chemistry module is enabled, so no H-bond, functional-group, charge, protonation, or tautomer claim is made. The terminal elements C,C,N for interface15 and C,O for interface16 are recorded as terminal element labels only; per source/limits, element fraction is not a verified H-bond or functional-group role, and terminal roles select support but are not asserted in early states. The pocket_sites listed for interface15 (A:VAL:53:CG1, A:MET:163:CE, A:HIS:160:CE1, A:HIS:160:NE2) are recorded as geometric pocket references, not as verified interaction partners. No element or charge probability is treated as a receptor or donor/acceptor probability.
clock_and_representation: Clock policy is fixed, matching the catalog entry for G000. The observable contract is predictive_bridge_to_learning_end with teacher actual_ancestor_at_learning_end. The ancestor tool returns two representations that must not be exchanged: actual current world A and same-forward teacher predicted endpoint world A, sampled at clock times 0.0, 0.12, 0.25, 0.5 over domain [0.0, 0.5]. The selection_trend tool uses weights from score_time applied to the proposal at state_time, and excludes proposals beyond the learning window; its feature definition uses current-time teacher coordinates only for local correspondence. The learning window is [0.0, 0.5] and the parent program uses teacher_time 0.5, so the endpoint target and the learning-end ancestor are the same clock time and must not be swapped with the current-state target.
falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if, with numerical option A000 held fixed, the interface15 support produces no measurable change in the predictive-bridge observable relative to the parent response, or if the local focal features leave the reported focal_feature_range without a corresponding endpoint change. It is also falsified if the narrower interface16 support (2 slots, C,O, no orientation triplet) produces an equal or larger effect, which would show that support size and orientation content are not the discriminating factor. A further falsifier is any result where the parent's measured response statistics (assignment_switch_fraction, current_gradient_rms_mean, point_rms_A) are unchanged, indicating the support was not actually engaged.
formation_retention_value_test: Formation: whether the selected slots [4,14,15] move toward the same-forward teacher endpoint coordinates returned by the ancestor tool at the learning end. Retention: whether the local focal features returned by selection_trend stay within the reported focal_feature_range across the window rather than collapsing. Value: whether the parent program's measured response (parents/R15_V3_COMPATIBLE/response, program R19_v2, 40 active updates, no atom clipping, dose_gain 1.0) is reproduced or improved when the same numerical option A000 is applied to this support. The parent outcome to beat is best_qualified_pic50 8.590141296386719 with n_above_target 0, so any value claim must be stated against that record and not against the incumbent.
observable_change: Under the fixed clock policy, the observable is the predictive bridge to the learning end: the model's predicted endpoint for the selected slots is compared against the actual ancestor at the learning end (time 0.5). The ancestor tool supplies both the actual current-world coordinates and the same-forward teacher endpoint coordinates for slots [4,14,15] at the four sampled clock times, so the Designer can bind the pointwise reward to the same-forward teacher endpoint representation. The selection_trend tool supplies the focal kernel-occupancy and signed kernel-weighted displacement features (units dimensionless, A, A, A) with feature centers at the three fixed terminal local points, so the observable change can be read as a shift in those local features rather than as a whole-cloud RMS.
relationship_to_failed_families: The prior campaign readout reports that a 3-point N/C region (R16) and a 4-point O region (R18) did not replicate the wider 20/25-point support benefit, and that local identity formation did not equal affinity benefit. This hypothesis is a direct response to that failure family: it tests whether a 3-slot support with an orientation triplet behaves differently from the previously failed 3-point region, rather than assuming that any local support works. The parent R15_V3_COMPATIBLE outcome shows n_above_target 0 and best_qualified_pic50 8.590141296386719, so the failed family is not treated as resolved. The source/limits note that finite historical selected paths are not calibrated continuation probabilities, so no failure is written as a proven impossibility.
scientific_hypothesis: The interface15 support (atom_slots [4,14,15], terminal elements C,C,N, with orientation triplet [15,4,14]) is a real ancestral local region: the ancestor tool returns actual current-world coordinates at clock times 0.0, 0.12, 0.25, 0.5 and same-forward teacher endpoint predictions for all three slots, so the region is not fabricated. The selection_trend tool returns a focal feature range and per-time focal/background/expected-selection/native-shift rows over 51 times with unique_controls between 28 and 49, so the region has a measurable local feature trajectory along the single successful path. The hypothesis is that this 3-slot support with an orientation triplet is a better-conditioned local guidance target than the narrower 2-slot interface16 support, because the prior campaign readout reports that a 3-point N/C region did not replicate the wider-support benefit, implying support background and neighborhood composition matter. This is a local-support-identity hypothesis only; the numerical program is held identical to the parent and no affinity derivative is claimed.
support_reason: G000 is selected because its regional evidence was actually queried: the ancestor tool returned real coordinates and teacher endpoints for slots [4,14,15], and the selection_trend tool returned a full 51-time focal/background/selection-shift record with unique_controls between 28 and 49. The support is strictly local (3 slots plus one orientation triplet), the needed neighbors are included in the pocket_sites, and the numerical option A000 is the only option in the group, so the Designer chooses only within that option. The contrast with interface16 (2 slots, no orientation triplet) is the minimal discriminating pair, and interface16's controller_response shows the parent record is bound to R15_V3_COMPATIBLE with the same program, so the comparison is against the correct parent and not the incumbent.
